basic_details.job_title: C-MET Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 5 Project Associate, Project Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Centre for Materials for Electronics Technology (C-MET), a Scientific Society under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India, will hold walk-in interviews at C-MET, Thrissur, Kerala on 20 November 2026 for Project Associate-I and on 23 November 2026 for Project Assistant I, with registration between 08.00 hrs and 10.30 hrs on the respective dates. There are 3 Project Associate-I posts at Rs. 30,000/- per month plus HRA and 2 Project Assistant I posts at Rs. 18,000/- (likely to be revised) per month plus HRA, in a MeitY-sponsored scientific project.

age_limit.details: For both posts the age limit is not exceeding General - 28 years, SC and ST - 33 years and OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) - 31 years, as on 31.10.2026. Candidates claiming age relaxation must produce valid documents as proof.

First Class/ 60% marks in Diploma (3 year) in Electrical OR Mechanical Engineering

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Both posts are temporary and project based. The tenure of the Project Associate-I post is co-terminus with the project; the tenure of the Project Assistant I post is co-terminus with the technical service, as printed in the notice. For both posts the age limit is not exceeding General - 28 years, SC and ST - 33 years and OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) - 31 years, as on 31.10.2026. Candidates claiming age relaxation must produce valid documents as proof. The present vacancies are earmarked for the Un-Reserved Category. SC/ST and OBC (NCL) candidates claiming age relaxation may also apply for consideration for future vacancies against the reserved categories in the project. The notice does not name any other eligibility condition such as experience. Candidates should check the official notification for the full details of each post.

rows.qualification: First Class/ 60% marks in Physics, Materials Science or Nanoscience
First Class/ 60% marks in Diploma (3 year) in Electrical OR Mechanical Engineering
rows.pay: Rs. 18,000/- (Likely to be revised) per month plus HRA.

content_sections.heading: C-MET Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Preparation of various thin films by RF/DC sputtering techniques for surface plasmon resonance applications. Evaluation of electrical and optical properties. Characterisation of the films for biosensor applications. Design and fabrication of surface plasmon based portable biosensor. Validation of the device developed in the laboratory and relevant environments. Laser assisted cutting of coated films with specific dimensions for device applications. Design and fabrication of experimental setup for validation studies. Design/fabrication of final sensor. Jigs/Fixtures designing for coating machines.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Originals along with copies of documents in support of Qualification, Age, Experience etc. A passport size photograph. Valid documents as proof, for candidates claiming age relaxation. A non-creamy layer certificate issued for "Central Govt. Employment Purpose", for OBC (NCL) candidates claiming age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Registration is between 08.00 hrs and 10.30 hrs at C-MET, Thrissur on the date for the post: 20 November 2026 for Project Associate-I and 23 November 2026 for Project Assistant I. If more candidates turn up, a written test in the relevant subject will be conducted for initial screening. Only candidates screened in by a committee will be considered for interview, subject to verification of original documents.

faq.question: Q1. When is the C-MET walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for Project Associate-I is on 20 November 2026 and for Project Assistant I on 23 November 2026, at C-MET, Thrissur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue?
faq.answer: Registration is between 08.00 hrs and 10.30 hrs on the respective dates at C-MET, Thrissur.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 5 posts in total: 3 Project Associate-I and 2 Project Assistant I, all earmarked for the Un-Reserved Category.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: First Class/ 60% marks in Physics, Materials Science or Nanoscience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Project Assistant I?
faq.answer: First Class/ 60% marks in Diploma (3 year) in Electrical OR Mechanical Engineering.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Not exceeding General - 28 years, SC and ST - 33 years and OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) - 31 years, as on 31.10.2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the C-MET posts?
faq.answer: Project Associate-I gets Rs. 30,000/- per month plus HRA. Project Assistant I gets Rs. 18,000/- (likely to be revised) per month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q8. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice states both posts are paid the stated amount "per month plus HRA".

faq.question: Q9. What should I bring to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Originals along with copies of documents in support of Qualification, Age, Experience etc. and a passport size photograph. Candidates claiming age relaxation must bring valid proof, and OBC (NCL) candidates a non-creamy layer certificate for Central Govt. Employment Purpose.

faq.question: Q10. How are candidates selected, and is the job permanent?
faq.answer: If more candidates turn up, a written test in the relevant subject is held for initial screening, and only those screened in by a committee are considered for interview. The posts are purely temporary, co-terminus with the project, and give no right to regular appointment.
